title: Ferguson Announces Intention to Cancel Secondary Listing on London Stock Exchange
summary: Ferguson Enterprises Inc. (“ Ferguson ” or the “ Company ”) (NYSE: FERG; LSE: FERG) today announced its intention to cancel: (i) the secondary listing of the Company’s common stock (“ Common Stock ”) on the Equity Shares (international commercial companies secondary listing) category of the Official List (the “ Official List ”) of the U.K. Financial Conduct Authority (“ FCA ”); and (ii) the admission to trading of its Common Stock on the London Stock Exchange’s (“ LSE ”) main market for listed securities (together, the “ London Delisting ”) with effect from July 20, 2026. Background to and reasons for the London Delisting Since 2019, the Company’s board of directors (the “ Board ”) has considered North America to be the best long-term location for Ferguson and has worked methodically and transparently with shareholders on this transformative journey.
